dimensions.note: No credentials, environment access, or external services.
The method logs structured entry and completion events without input data.
All validation and freshness failures occur before the sole resource write and return sorted diagnostics.
Tests cover success, threshold boundaries, missing and malformed data, authority tampering, unit mismatches, unsafe arithmetic, strict schemas, stale evidence, and repeated requests.
A requestId deterministically selects one instance name; repeated equivalent requests write byte-equivalent validated content.
No network or external API calls.
No files, connections, subprocesses, or temporary resources are opened.
README and fixtures contain only synthetic identifiers and values.
Global, method, nested input, and persisted output object schemas are strict; persisted output is re-derived and checked against deterministic evaluation.
The summary resource declares infinite lifetime and bounded garbage collection.
This is a recommendation summary recorder, not an external CRUD lifecycle model.
The operation validates caller input and only persists Swamp data; it has no external mutation.
The sole write targets summary with a validated requestId-derived name; no cross-spec collision exists.
The deterministic method does not read or mutate stored lifecycle state.
This is the initial unpublished version.
